title: Org to org control plane
invariant: A principal with no membership in org B cannot read, list, mutate or learn the existence of any resource of org B.
required_config: none beyond a correctly operated database
not_guaranteed: authorization is enforced in services, not by the data layer (no row-level security)
superadmins can read every org
residual_risk: a missing scope check in one route
no cross-tenant sweep over all authenticated routes
test_gaps: cross-tenant sweep of every authenticated route: none

title: Project to project inside an org
invariant: A principal holds exactly the rights of their project role; project-scoped tokens, MCP grants, exec sessions and minted tokens cannot reach other projects or exceed their parent.
not_guaranteed: project editors are trusted with their own project: exec into app pods and read bound environment
org owners and admins see every project
residual_risk: role x token x grant x route matrix is not tested
test_gaps: full role x route matrix: none

title: Tenant network
invariant: A tenant pod reaches only its own namespace, DNS, ingress namespaces on serving ports, the public internet outside private ranges, node and apiserver addresses, other tenants' published pods and the backup proxy; no platform pod accepts a connection from a tenant namespace.
required_config: TENANT_INGRESS_NAMESPACES (tenant.ingressNamespaces) when the controller is not in network or orchard
PLATFORM_EXTRA_DENY_CIDRS (tenant.extraDenyCidrs) for public LB IPs and service CIDR
Cilium entity denies are automatic when Cilium is detected
not_guaranteed: no enforcement without an enforcing CNI
IPv6 is default-denied, not filtered
published pods of other tenants are reachable
allow-cilium-ingress admits host and remote-node entities
residual_risk: public apiserver or LB address missing from the computed excepts
no live check that policies are enforced
test_gaps: live enforcement (pod A cannot reach pod B, apiserver, node): none

title: Tenant compute
invariant: Every object a tenant can cause to exist has a shape Orchard builds; a tenant process cannot affect the host kernel or other tenants when a sandbox runtime is configured.
required_config: tenantSandbox.enabled with a runtime installed on every node (optional)
user-namespace sysctl on build nodes for rootless builds
not_guaranteed: tenant pods share the host kernel by default
rootless builds share the node kernel with Unconfined seccomp and AppArmor
database pods are not sandboxed unless databases.runtimeClassName is set
admission policies are Warn,Audit by default and fail open
residual_risk: kernel and runtime escapes
TENANT_RUNTIME_CLASS unset leaves pods on the node runtime
test_gaps: admission policies against a live API server: manual procedure only

title: Builds
invariant: A build for project A cannot read project B's source, secrets, cache or registry images, cannot push to another project's repository and cannot reach the cluster.
required_config: REGISTRY_IMAGE_POLICY enforce or auto, with registry hosts set
r2-proxy enabled and serving the cache bucket (BUILDKIT_S3_VIA_PROXY, r2Proxy.allowedBuckets)
not_guaranteed: the registry login is one credential for all tenants
with BUILDER_SIDECAR_PUSH=false the shared login is placed in the build or Depot session
without the r2-proxy the S3 cache key is instance-wide
residual_risk: shared registry login
compromise of the pusher container
node-kernel exploits from a Dockerfile RUN step without Kata
test_gaps: cross-tenant cache or registry attack against a live cluster: none

title: Secrets
invariant: A secret value is readable only by principals with edit rights on its project and the workload it is bound to, never returned by read APIs once written, and not readable by other tenants.
not_guaranteed: plaintext storage when the key is unset
one instance-wide key for all orgs
wildcard database TLS key is copied into tenant namespaces with a public database in the default mode
residual_risk: plaintext storage on a misconfigured Helm install
shared key for all orgs
test_gaps: fail closed when the key is missing: none

title: Storage and backups
invariant: A tenant's backup credentials, build cache keys, uploads and restores touch only that tenant's bucket prefix, and the platform object-store credentials never reach a tenant namespace.
required_config: separate bucket or key for uploads
not_guaranteed: org-supplied backup buckets use the org's own credential
residual_risk: a flaw in the SigV4 prefix check
storage scrubbing after deletion depends on the StorageClass
test_gaps: backup and restore across tenants end to end: none

title: Observability
invariant: A user sees logs, metrics, events and status of only the projects they can view; a tenant workload cannot query the platform metrics or log stores.
required_config: networkPolicy.platform.enabled and a CNI that enforces it
VictoriaMetrics and VictoriaLogs not exposed outside the cluster
not_guaranteed: namespaces that are not classed as tenant or untrusted can reach the stores unless listed in networkPolicy.platform.untrustedNamespaces
residual_risk: not every metrics query path was audited

title: Identity
invariant: An IdP, SCIM token or SSO session belonging to org A can create, sign in or modify only identities and memberships within org A.
required_config: verify the organization's domains before enforcing SSO
not_guaranteed: the IdP is trusted for the identity and group membership of its own users within its own org
group rules cannot grant owner
residual_risk: no property tests for SAML, SCIM and OAuth lineage
test_gaps: property tests for SAML, SCIM, OAuth lineage: none

title: Ingress and browser origin
invariant: Only the project that holds a hostname receives its traffic; a tenant app cannot read or set the dashboard credentials or obtain a certificate for a host it does not control.
required_config: app domain on the Public Suffix List and a different registrable domain from the dashboard
COOKIE_DOMAIN unset or not a parent of the app domain
TRUST_PROXY, TRUSTED_PROXY_RANGES, TRUST_CLOUDFLARE, CLIENT_IP_HEADER and CLIENT_IP_HEADER_FROM matching the topology
not_guaranteed: custom-domain verification is off by default
the session cookie has no __Host- prefix
the chart does not lock the origin or check the Public Suffix List
public hostnames with their own certificates appear in Certificate Transparency logs
residual_risk: host squatting before verification is on
operator misconfiguration of the app domain or origin
test_gaps: cookie scope against the real app domain: none

title: Resource fairness
invariant: One tenant cannot exhaust CPU, memory, pods, volumes, load balancers or request budget beyond its configured share.
not_guaranteed: no CPU or memory quota without org caps
no node-level isolation by default
residual_risk: an org with no caps can consume node CPU and memory

title: Lifecycle
invariant: After deletion, transfer or revocation nothing of the removed object remains reachable by the previous owner or a successor tenant.
not_guaranteed: the namespace keeps the former slug after a transfer
storage scrubbing depends on the StorageClass
residual_risk: slug disclosure to cluster operators
data remanence on the storage backend
